source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: The issue of attributive modification is closely connected to the issue of adverbial modification. In the preceding section it has been demonstrated that adjectives can modify nouns but cannot modify adjectives (cf. (121)). Adjectives also cannot modify verbs. However, if they are turned into adverbs, it becomes possible for them to modify both verbs and adjectives.
